name: wholesale
custom_duck_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(db.system_book_code, regexp_extract(w.filename,'wholesale_detail/([0-9]+)/',1)) AS sbc,
  substr(w.audit_time,1,4)||substr(w.audit_time,6,2)||substr(w.audit_time,9,2) AS bizday,
  CAST(SUM(CAST(w.wholesale_money AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wholesale_money,
  CAST(SUM(CAST(w.wholesale_profit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wholesale_profit
FROM read_parquet('s3://lemeng-datasource/lemeng/wholesale_detail/**/all.parquet', filename=true, union_by_name=true) w
LEFT JOIN read_parquet('s3://lemeng-datasource/dims/dim_branch.parquet') db ON db.system_book_code='64188' AND db.branch_name=w.client_name
WHERE substr(w.audit_time,1,4)||substr(w.audit_time,6,2)||substr(w.audit_time,9,2) BETWEEN '{{fromCompact}}' AND '{{toCompact}}'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

name: item_outbound
custom_duck_sql:
WITH delivery AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(filename,'transfer_detail/([0-9]+)/',1) AS sbc,
    substr(order_time,1,4)||substr(order_time,6,2)||substr(order_time,9,2) AS bizday,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(out_money AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS delivery_amount,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(profit_money AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS delivery_profit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://lemeng-datasource/lemeng/transfer_detail/**/all.parquet', filename=true, union_by_name=true)
  WHERE substr(order_time,1,4)||substr(order_time,6,2)||substr(order_time,9,2) BETWEEN '{{fromCompact}}' AND '{{toCompact}}'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
wholesale AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(db.system_book_code, regexp_extract(w.filename,'wholesale_detail/([0-9]+)/',1)) AS sbc,
    substr(w.audit_time,1,4)||substr(w.audit_time,6,2)||substr(w.audit_time,9,2) AS bizday,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(w.wholesale_money AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wholesale_amount,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(w.wholesale_profit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS wholesale_profit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://lemeng-datasource/lemeng/wholesale_detail/**/all.parquet', filename=true, union_by_name=true) w
  LEFT JOIN read_parquet('s3://lemeng-datasource/dims/dim_branch.parquet') db ON db.system_book_code='64188' AND db.branch_name=w.client_name
  WHERE substr(w.audit_time,1,4)||substr(w.audit_time,6,2)||substr(w.audit_time,9,2) BETWEEN '{{fromCompact}}' AND '{{toCompact}}'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.sbc,w.sbc) AS sbc,
  COALESCE(d.bizday,w.bizday) AS bizday,
  COALESCE(d.delivery_amount,0) AS delivery_amount,
  COALESCE(d.delivery_profit,0) AS delivery_profit,
  COALESCE(w.wholesale_amount,0) AS wholesale_amount,
  COALESCE(w.wholesale_profit,0) AS wholesale_profit
FROM delivery d FULL OUTER JOIN wholesale w ON d.sbc=w.sbc AND d.bizday=w.bizday
ORDER BY 1,2
